description: The change events after the hello, one per variant in the order the bus emits them: activity, usage, turn-start, turn-end, agent-run, live-session. Each is what the handler writes for that bus type (the route forwards only type and at, coalesced to one per type per 250 ms). Transcribed from routes/os.mjs writeEvent, with the timestamps fixed; the handler is driven in-process, not over a socket, so a real turn or run is not needed.
